## What and why
Describe the change and the reason for it. Link the issue it closes, if any (`Closes #123`).

## How it was tested
- [ ] `cargo test` passes
- [ ] I ran the app and tried the change

## Checklist
- [ ] One change per pull request
- [ ] For a larger feature or behavior change, I opened an issue first and we agreed on the approach
- [ ] Tests added or updated for logic changes
- [ ] I ran `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy`
- [ ] The code matches the style of the surrounding code
- [ ] No new dependencies, or each new one is needed and uses an OSI-approved license with no commercial license required
- [ ] No proprietary code, incompatibly licensed code, or assets I don't have the right to distribute
- [ ] This is not a security fix that should have been reported privately (see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/TeutonicTerrror/TerrorLink/security/policy))
- [ ] I agree my contribution is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later
